brief: Local review cut: detailed knowledge-graph header logo at tablet/phone widths; dusk; continuous neon flow reflected in the chrome and water; closer levitating sphere; localized white ground glow; optional exact-logo imprint.

iterations.status: Rejected: jagged lightning; retained as provenance
iterations.prompt:
Edit the supplied SalvorLabs hero photograph. This is a targeted art-direction cut, not a redesign. Preserve the same composition, camera, realistic mirrored chrome sphere, scale and placement, distant infinite desert horizon, cracked dry ground, still shallow pool and the sphere's reflection. Preserve the single perfect sphere as a polished reflective solid object. Original composition is 1672x941, wide 16:9: sphere center x=50%, y=59%; sphere diameter about 13% of frame width; horizon y=57%; ground contact y=70%. Match these positions and scale closely. Keep landscape format.

Requested changes:
1. Shift the scene to deeper dusk: deep navy twilight sky, very subdued distant warm horizon, dimmer desert. Keep the upper 45% of the image quietly dark and low detail because white website headline and navigation will be placed there as real HTML. This is dusk, still photographically readable, not an outer-space scene.
2. Add elegant restrained neon electricity wrapping through the space immediately surrounding the chrome sphere. Delicate irregular arcing filaments with brilliant tiny white cores and soft pale icy-blue/cyan light, with at most a faint lavender undertone. A few arcs curl around the sides and behind the sphere and near its base. It should feel like a contained electrical field, with spatial depth, not a flat Saturn ring, neon signage, an explosion, or decorative UI lines. Keep the arcs near the sphere, below y=49%; do not invade the headline's dark sky.
3. Essential physical coherence: the nearby electrical arcs must visibly appear as curved, compressed light reflections on the mirrored metal, matching their actual positions around it, and reflect naturally in the water below. Maintain the sphere's reflections of the horizon, desert and dusky sky. Make the light feel present in this exact environment.
4. Add a localized soft WHITE pool of light directly on the ground/water beneath the sphere. Light nearby crack edges and its contact region, with realistic falloff. Keep this white glow compact in the middle-lower frame around the sphere's base, not across the foreground or sky. Do not bleach the lower-center edge where a white navigation link will sit.
5. Keep the central front of the sphere relatively uncluttered so an exact supplied vector brand glyph can later be composited there. Do not generate any emblem, logo, letters, words, labels or text into this photograph.

Minimal cinematic photographic finish, genuine metallic reflection, grounded restrained light, no other objects, no spheres added, no people, no interface, no text. Preserve the original concept of uncaptured knowledge extending to an infinite horizon.

Edit the supplied dusk sphere photograph. Keep the sphere, its placement and size, deep dusk sky, desert horizon, cracked earth, water pool, chrome reflections and localized white ground glow. Preserve the overall 1672x941 wide composition.

Correct ONLY the energy treatment: the energy must be a lively, CONTINUOUS FLOW OF NEON LIGHT. Remove every lightning bolt, branching electrical discharge, jagged zigzag, forked tendril and spark completely. Replace them with elegant smooth fluid curves, like a long-exposure photograph of luminous silk or flowing plasma. Use 2 or 3 fine flowing trails that curl loosely through 3D space around the sphere at different angles, with gently tapered intensity and a little graceful irregular motion. Predominantly icy-blue/cyan light with tiny white cores and a restrained blue-violet edge. Curves should have long, smooth rounded arcs with NO sharp corners and NO branching at all. They must feel alive and organic, not a regular rigid Saturn ring, cage, thick ribbon, or a geometric lightbulb.

The trails pass behind and in front of the sphere with plausible occlusion and depth. Make their curved neon light realistically reflect and compress onto the chrome sphere, and mirror in the water, matching the flow's actual location. Keep the sphere clearly visible and reflective of this exact twilight environment. Keep the white ground glow contained directly beneath the sphere and reflected in the pool.

Keep all neon concentrated in the middle-lower frame near the sphere. Upper 45% remains quiet dark sky for white HTML text. Bottom-center edge also stays dark enough for a white website link. No words, no logo, no generated emblem, no other objects. Cinematic restrained photorealism; smooth luminous flow, absolutely no actual lightning.

Make a focused edit to this existing SalvorLabs dusk hero. Preserve the same deep navy dusk desert, thin muted warm horizon, cinematic chrome, smooth continuous icy-blue NEON FLOW, localized white pool of light, and physically coherent reflections. Absolutely no lightning, sparks or branching electric bolts.

Only requested composition changes:
- Bring the same single reflective sphere CLOSER TO THE CAMERA, so its visible diameter is about 1.35 to 1.45 times its current diameter. Still retain plenty of wide infinite desert on each side and the dark sky for a website headline. Do not make it fill the frame.
- Lift the sphere slightly into the air. It must visibly LEVITATE with a small clear air gap beneath its lowest point, about 10-15% of the sphere diameter. Show the gap clearly with a soft dark contact shadow and contained white neon light on the ground/water beneath, rather than resting it on another object. No pedestal or support.
- Update the chrome environment and neon-flow reflections, the water reflection, contact shadow and white ground glow to match the new closer elevated sphere. The water reflection must be separated naturally from the actual sphere by the air gap.
- Let the smooth neon flow coil loosely around the elevated sphere at different depths. Keep the prominent trails around its sides, equator and lower part; do not send a tall loop into the headline area. Maintain mostly slender curving white/icy-blue cores with soft blue halos and at most a subtle violet edge. The chrome must reflect this light; no plain unlit orb.
- Keep the overall sphere centered horizontally, its center approximately y=60% of the frame, its diameter approximately 18-19% of the full image width. Preserve the 1672x941 wide landscape composition.
- Upper 43% of image stays dark, quiet and free of bright flow so white website text can remain fully readable. Keep the bottom-center edge dark enough for a white link.

Retain photographic realism and restraint. This is a reflective metal sphere suspended in the existing physical twilight scene, not a glass ball, not a planet or a robot. No lettering, text, logos or emblem in the generated photo; exact brand artwork will be composed separately.

branding: Exact existing PNG graph mark, composed in HTML/SVG; no generated logo or wordmark
